text: In modal HoTT, a crisp variable (in the flat context ♭) differs from an ordinary variable in that:
choices: it is treated as a set-level variable not subject to cohesive structure
it only applies to natural numbers
explanation: Crisp variables (in the ♭-context) are 'discrete': they carry no cohesive/geometric information. The flat modality extracts the underlying discrete set.
